testEvidence.command: Hosted CI run 35385091372 on head b69e718
testEvidence.result: Failed at the test step: 105/106 with PostgresException 53300 (too many clients) in PgTestSchema.CreateAsync. Root cause: each per-test schema owns its own Npgsql pool and idle connections accumulated past the hosted runner default max_connections=100. Fix: cap every per-schema test pool at Maximum Pool Size=3 in PgTestSchema (local re-run 106/106 passed; local cluster max_connections stays 200). An initdb-level change was rejected because initdb does not accept max_connections.

Hosted AuditSphereOps CI passed every step: setup-dotnet, tool restore, restore, build, EF migration, the 106-test suite, migration-aware readiness, and cleanup. The bounded per-schema test pool resolved the prior 53300 connection exhaustion.
